descricao: The hallways are assumed to be ever-changing. Shifting and shaping into something new every once in a while. The hallways can become impossible to navigate or be blocked off. Though these hallways are odd, there is one constant. The doors that repeat on either side of the halls are always there. These doors can lead to random places in The Backrooms, including Negative and sub-sections. More often than not, they will cause you to appear somewhere else in Level 21 or put you on a wall. Doors composed of sandstone can lead to Level 46.
